source.notes: arch-073 (A13 score/reducer). Flash-KATA / KATA-SPD: causal score A[t,s] = Σ_g (scale·q_g·k_g)² (concat-SPD; head splits into num_groups groups), scale = 1/sqrt(E) with E = head_dim/num_groups, all scores ≥ 0, future masked to 0; output o = (Σ_s A·v_s)/max(Σ_s A, 1) — a positive squared-group-dot score with sum normalization (no softmax, no epsilon). The typed K1ReducerLaw.SQUARED_SUM reducer with squared_sum_groups. Verified against the pinned kata parallel_kata_attn.py. Layer module: architectures/kata.py.

params.axis: A13 score/reducer: SQUARED_SUM reducer (positive squared-group-dot score, sum normalization)

coverage.notes: Parity vs the independent torch reference of the SPD-concat identity, the non-negative/causal invariants (future-token perturbation leaves earlier outputs unchanged), and gradients in tests/test_architectures_kata.py. The offset gate (<q,k> + a_t·a_s)², GDN-style decay A·exp(min(c_t−c_s,0)), qk-norm, the quadratic_sum variant and any native kernel are residual, not claimed.
